answer.report_md:
**画出来要什么**

需重建单面板多点区间图：27个国家、3个年龄组用三角形/菱形/圆形表示，并以竖线连接；含粗零线、负值、显著性深浅色、上方图例、纵排国家名、轮次分组带及注释来源。

**定位一个值难在哪**

“1”的5%容差仅±0.05，但纵轴每10分一格且没有数值标签；多个接近零的点也令国家与年龄组无法唯一反推。

**不确定的**

连接线未计入81个点标记；两个“13”及“12”“8”在图上都有多个近似候选，无法仅凭给定数值唯一定位。

heading.title: Change in the gap in literacy proficiency between adults with highly educated and medium-/low-educated parents, by age
heading.subtitle: Change between cycles in the mean score difference between adults with at least one tertiary-educated parent and adults with parents with at most an upper secondary education (Cycle 2 minus Cycle 1)

axes.serves: all point markers by country or economy
all countries grouped by survey round

worked_example.why_hard: No value label; 10-point ticks make the required precision demanding.

components.evidence: Triangle, diamond, and circle point symbols are overlaid with vertical connector segments.
A heavy horizontal rule crosses the plot at the labelled 0 tick.
The value axis extends to -30 and points fall below the heavy zero line.
The note says “Darker colours denote differences that are statistically significant at the 5% level.”
“Note:” and “Source:” lines are printed directly beneath the figure.
The age-group legend sits between the subtitle and the plot.
“Score-point difference” appears above the left value-axis ticks.
“Score-point difference” is placed above the top-left of the value axis.
The category label “Poland*” links to the “*Caution” note.
Country labels sit above a second row headed “Round, Cycle 1:” with 1, 2, 3.
Country tick labels from “Sweden” to “Hungary” are rotated vertically.

new_components.name: multi_point_connector_line
new_components.evidence: Each country has three age-group points joined by one vertical segment.

new_components.name: category_group_band
new_components.evidence: A grey band below countries labels groups 1, 2, and 3 under “Round, Cycle 1:”.

new_components.name: paired_marker_state_legend
new_components.evidence: Each age-group legend item shows adjacent light or open and dark markers.

spot_checks.mark: Several near-zero points could read 1 on the 10-point grid.
Several triangles, diamonds, and circles lie near 13, so the mark is not unique.
Both the Czechia circle and Hungary triangle lie near 12.
Multiple age-group markers lie near 13 and no values are printed.
Several country and age-group markers lie near 8 on the shared axis.

answer.hardest_step_why: “1”的5%容差仅±0.05；纵轴每10分一格且无数值标签，即使年龄与国家明确也难达精度。追踪到第2步。包含多个13及近零点也加剧歧义。图形为散点连线。需要估读。第二步最难。轴读值不足。误差明显。无法精确。尤其1。精度卡住。故选2。图上未打印。刻度粗。要求严。值小。容差极小。读图不够。定位尚可。数值不行。最终阻塞。第2步。确认。无标签。10分间隔。±0.05。无法。结束。结论明确。第二步。精度问题。非上下文。非表格。核心是读值。故为2。
